line.a_ksiazka.text: Bunny, I have a new picture book. I'll read it to you!

line.a_szybko.text: Give it, give it, quick, I want to see!

line.a_ojej.text: Oh no! The pages fell out. I'll put them back right now!

line.a_czyta_zle.text: Let's read. First there was the hen, then the egg, and last a chick hatched out of the egg... Hmm.

line.a_smieszne.text: Hee hee, something's wrong here. The chick hatches at the end, but the hen was at the start?

line.a_po_kolei.text: Because the pages are mixed up. A story happens in order: first, then, and last.

line.a_uloz.text: Help us put the pages in order. What came first? Start at the arrow.

line.zla_kolejnosc.text: That's not its place. What happens earlier, and what later?

line.a_czyta_dobrze.text: First there was an egg, then a chick hatched out of the egg, and last the chick grew up into a hen.

line.a_ma_sens.text: Now it makes sense! Egg, chick, hen.

line.b_nasiono.text: In the garden everything happens in order too. Look, I'm planting a seed.

line.b_najpierw.text: First a seed in the soil.

line.b_na_koncu.text: And last a flower! A tulip.

line.b_uloz.text: The pictures got mixed up. Put them in order, start at the arrow.

line.b_balwan.text: I drew a story about a snowman, but I lost one page from the middle.

line.b_ktora.text: First one snowball, last a finished snowman. What came in between? Point to it.

line.b_ktora_nie.text: That page is from another story. We're looking for the snowman.

line.b_balwan_ok.text: Yes! Two snowballs, and only then the hat and the scarf. The story is whole.

line.b_wyscig.text: And now a race! Who'll get to the tree first?

line.b_kto_pierwszy.text: Who was first? Point to them.

line.b_kto_ostatni.text: And who was last? Point to them.

line.b_ostatnia.text: I was last. I have short little legs!

line.p_start.text: Let's play with stories! I have five games.

line.p_ciasto.text: How do you bake a cake? Put the pictures in order.

line.p_co_pierwsze.text: What came first: the hen or the egg? In our book. Point to it.

line.p_co_pierwsze_nie.text: In our story the egg came first.

line.p_jajko.text: The egg! And out of the egg a chick.

line.p_ostatnie.text: What comes last in this story? Point to it.

line.p_ostatnie_nie.text: That comes earlier. What grows at the very end?

line.p_kwiat.text: The flower! The flower comes last.

line.p_memory.text: Turn the cards and find the pairs.

line.d_kanapka.text: Let's make a sandwich for supper.

line.d_uloz.text: First bread, then butter, and last cheese. Put the pictures in order.

line.d_rodzice.text: Tell your parents a story in three pictures: what came first, what next, and what last.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping with my book! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the chick from Owl's book. We got it when we put stories in order.
